_readme: Keyword map the daily SEO job works from. Clusters are ordered by priority. `covered` maps a keyword to the URL that targets it; the job publishes new posts for the highest-priority uncovered keyword whose intent we can serve. Refresh volumes/KD from Ahrefs (seo/data/ahrefs-latest.json) - the numbers here are planning estimates, not measurements.
